sentences.text: learned counsel for the appellant.
Ms. Padam Shri Agrawal- P.L.- appearing on behalf of Advocate General.
Heard on the question of admission.
This appeal appears to be arguable, hence, it is admitted for final hearing.

Also heard on I.A. No.
12193 of 2023, which is Ist application under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved by the sole appellant - Shyam Singh.
T his Criminal Appeal assails the judgment dated 16.06.2023 passed by 7th Additional Sessions Judge, District Gwalior in Sessions Trial No. 6400118/2016, whereby appellant has been convicted and sentenced to undergo imprisonment as under :-
Conviction U/s Sentence Fine (in Rs.) Default (in lieu of fine) 468 of IPC 3 years RI 3,000/- Six Months RI 471 of IPC 1 year RI 1.000/- Four Months RI 420 of IPC 3 years RI 3,000/- Six months RI
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the trial Court has wrongly convicted the appellant.
There are material omissions and contradictions in the evidence of prosecution witnesses.
No active role of the present appellant has been proved by the prosecution in commission of offence.
The learned court below has already suspended the sentence of the appellant for a limited period.
The appellant was on bail during trial and he has not misused the liberty so granted to him.
Final hearing of this appeal will take long time.
Hence, prayed to suspend the jail sentence and grant of bail to the Counsel for the State vehemently opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the materials available on record.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on merits of the case,
I.A.No. 12193 of 2023 of 2023 is hereby allowed.

Subject to depositing of fine amount, if not already deposited, and on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail.

The appellant is further Shyam Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62674410/
1 directed to mark his appearance before the Office of this Court on 11/10/2023 and on subsequent dates given by the Office in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
